shelfmark: Durham University Library, Sudan Archive, Wingate Papers, SAD.250/1/81
date: 1884 (Nile Expedition; between SAD.250/1/72-79 of 25 Nov - 8 Dec 1884 and /82-83)
what: One card, 'Table of cypher codes for senior army personnel' (finding aid). A candidate key for the Arabic-numeral cipher family of the Nile Expedition and Gordon's note SAD.250/1/550 (candidates.json row 1); not tested.
